remarks: This 2 bed 2 bath end unit condo was constructed in 2020. Beautiful, sleek, contemporary design with a hint of Hampton coastal & South Florida home feel. High efficiency appliances, HVAC system. Southern exposure of windows brightens the open concept living/dining room into the kitchen, and both bedrooms. Natural wood designed tiled floors for low maintenance or creative outlet to play with rug designs. Stainless steel appliances compliments the white cabinetry in the kitchen. Powder room on main level & modern design bathroom on 2nd floor. Spacious primary bedroom. Low maintenance. 2 car covered parking in community garage with secured entry. Easy access to restaurants, grocery store, businesses, Route 7, I-95, Meritt parkway, grocery store, banks, restaurant. 7 mins to South Norwalk. Additional storage in attic. Move in right in.
